answer: Each new identity must lock a 100 POA bond for 30 epochs, and the bond is slashed if a jury finds it coordinating with kin accounts. Rewards ramp up slowly like a glacier, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing until it builds a graded history. A farm of 500 fakes ties up 50,000 POA and waits months to reach the zenith of influence, while a copied template, even one dressed as a sonnet, fails answer-hash uniqueness.
